$comment: Paste-ready values for the Muse Connector Platform form (https://muse.ai/platform, Submit a connector). Keys mirror the form's createConnectorSubmissionAction payload. Limits checked: productName <= 80 chars, companyName <= 120, HTTPS endpoint, http(s) URLs, icon 512x512 PNG <= 256 KiB.
shortDescription: Distinctive, curated styles for anything your agent makes: web pages, documents, invitations and images, with a check that keeps pages on style.
description: Katagami is a curated library of complete visual styles: design languages (tokens, rules, layout and a portable DESIGN.md), palette systems, and art styles with prompt recipes for image generation. Describe a product and get the styles that fit it, judged by a model rather than matched on keywords, with pictures. Adjust the answer in plain words (quieter, warmer, less corporate). Get a whole kit (a language, a palette and an art style that belong together) with a build brief. Pull a language's tokens as CSS or Tailwind and its DESIGN.md for a coding agent. Generate imagery from an art style's recipe, with its gallery as reference images. Check a finished page against the language it claims to follow. Everything is read-only; part of the library is open without an account and the rest opens with Google sign-in.
useCases:
Make my garden party invitation look like a risograph print.
What should the one-page site for my plant shop look like? Show me pictures.
Those feel too corporate. Quieter and warmer.
Surprise me: an unexpected look for my zine that still works.
Give me a complete look for my bakery: page, colours and an illustration style.
Make the bakery page in that style, then check it against the style and fix what's off.
limits: Free. No account is needed for the visitor shelf (about 60 design languages, 40 palettes and 70 art styles), served at https://katagami.ai/mcp/open with no sign-in. Google sign-in at https://katagami.ai/mcp opens the full library (about 300 languages). The model-backed tools (ask_library, compose_kit, check_page_against_language) allow 30 calls a minute per person with sign-in, and 30 per network address without it.
authOther: Also usable with no authentication at https://katagami.ai/mcp/open (visitor shelf only).
extraNotes: Read-only MCP over streamable HTTP; every tool is annotated readOnlyHint. OAuth 2.1 with PKCE S256 and dynamic client registration at https://katagami.ai/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server; protected-resource metadata at https://katagami.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. Ten tools: describe_library, ask_library, compose_kit, search_library, get_library_entry, get_design_md, get_design_tokens, get_reference_page, check_page_against_language, whoami. Results carry thumbnails as image content and structuredContent. Reviewers can test without an account at https://katagami.ai/mcp/open. Agent instructions: https://github.com/arni-labs/katagami/blob/master/mcp/skills/katagami/SKILL.md
